entries.title: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
entries.definitive_edition: Laysara: Summit Kingdom on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Laysara: Summit Kingdom left Early Access with a 1.0 launch on PC and consoles. Windows PC is the best primary route because the Steam release is the native PC build with the highest settings flexibility, while there is no console-exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam.
